tickets.title: Prepare pre-clearance narrative for stock sale
tickets.text: Prepare a pre-clearance narrative for Selene Velvetreed covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and confirmation of no material nonpublic information, to be submitted to Apricot Compass Advisory. She is a restricted employee at Tin Sparrow Robotics and wants to reduce single-company exposure, currently about 38% of household marketable investments, within employer trading rules.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to prepare pre-clearance narrative covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and no material nonpublic information to Apricot Compass Advisory.

tickets.title: Provide exercise cost and withholding scenarios
tickets.text: Provide Selene Velvetreed with before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios for her 4,000 vested nonqualified stock options with a $12.40 exercise price at Tin Sparrow Robotics. The vested options expire soon after the next blackout window, so timing is constrained.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-11 to provide before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios because vested options expire soon after the next blackout window.

tickets.title: Reconcile custody share feed with employer report
tickets.text: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody's 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares shown in the Tin Sparrow Robotics employer equity report for Selene Velvetreed. Resolve the 850-share discrepancy and confirm the correct available share count.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-10 to reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody’s 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares in the employer report.
